notes: This policy generates research review statuses only; it does not place orders.
Any single-name, parent-group or subgroup cap breach triggers a reduce/rebalance review, not an automatic sell.
An add research-watch status requires both DCF and forward-PE gates to pass, medium/high valuation confidence, validated data and verified available cash.
If cash is not supplied, no add status can be generated; this is not a claim that the account has zero cash.
ETF positions are not valued with company DCF/PE; they are reviewed through dated issuer look-through and the same portfolio concentration limits.
Price, data freshness, and valuation assumptions must be checked again before any manual order.
